description: This file defines the ICatalogViewModelService interface for a web application, specifying methods to retrieve catalog items, brands, and types asynchronously.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Returns a task that retrieves catalog items based on pagination and optional filtering by brand and type.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Returns a task that retrieves a list of brand selection items.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Returns a task that retrieves a list of type selection items.
